cohort: The study included low-income newborns classified as low-risk in The Netherlands, focusing on those born around the 37-week gestational age cutoff.
finding: Babies born slightly before the week-37 cutoff, who received physician supervision, were significantly less likely to die than babies born slightly later, who received midwife-only supervision.
mod_finding: Physician supervision of birth reduces the likelihood of emergency C-section.
gest_age: The study focuses on deliveries around the 37-week gestational age cutoff.
